method.registry: UI_COPY is imported by the V4 renderer and generator; fields, options, steps, layouts and pending rows are generated from the same authority-contract exports.
method.runtimeAudit: Focused Chromium traverses every layout and step plus menu/save/projects/error states; every visible semantic element must carry its own cited authority ID and resolve directly to either a UI_COPY ID or an exact generated-inventory key. Ancestor authority is never accepted.
